followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included November 2023 Gallabat passenger-departure restriction. It is distinct from earlier August 2023 closure/reopening reports. The restriction is on travel out of Sudan through Gallabat towards Ethiopia. Goods remain allowed; returned victims and other-country crossings are not additional closure cohorts. Retain the 19–20 November onset bound and last-confirmed 20 November. No matched reopening was found in the bounded retrieval; a last-confirmed day is not an endpoint or proof of continuous restriction to the study end. Reported passenger safety and robbery concerns support the existing Security assignments. The evidence does not support a goods prohibition or a new trade rationale. Dabanga and Sagia passages were directly read; Sudan Tribune’s exact-URL text was indexed after a direct 404. Possible shared reporting origin remains explicit; no multiple-origin certainty is claimed. The phase remains unlocated with no invented Gallabat coordinate. The missing baseline Dimensions row is recorded as a structural gap, not filled with guesses.
